onboarding.title: A little guidance, whenever you need it
onboarding.audience: How familiar are you with astrology?
onboarding.welcomeBody: Create your birth chart, explore your current life period, and find readings about the things that interest you. No astrology knowledge needed.
onboarding.chartTitle: Your chart is ready. Need a starting point?
onboarding.chartBody: Follow the highlighted controls to explore your chart and readings. You can jump to a topic or leave at any time.
onboarding.tourUnavailable: The chart introduction becomes available once your chart has loaded successfully. You can always reopen it from Help.
onboarding.introLead: Start with one useful reading. Explore the details at your own pace.
onboarding.intakeBody: Use your birth date, time, and birthplace. If you don't know the time, choose the approximate or unknown-time option in the form.
onboarding.methodBody: Unsure? Continue with our default, Lahiri with Whole Sign houses. You can compare methods later.
onboarding.readingBody: Read the short summary first, then explore life areas, timing, or the full reading. My Chart in the navigation returns you to your latest chart.
onboarding.interpretation: Planetary positions are calculated; readings interpret them within astrology. Interpretations describe possible themes, not guaranteed events. Some longer readings use AI-generated prose.
onboarding.uncertainTime: With an approximate or unknown birth time, rising signs, houses, and timing-sensitive readings may change. Treat those parts as tentative.
onboarding.defaultTitle: Not sure which method to choose?
onboarding.defaultBody: Start with Lahiri and Whole Sign houses, our default calculation. You can explore other methods later.
onboarding.methodExplain: The tradition sets the zodiac's reference point. The house system divides the chart into twelve life areas.
onboarding.detailsBody: Your birth date gives the planetary positions. Your birth time helps determine the rising sign and houses. Use the place you were born, even if you live elsewhere now. Recent charts stay in this browser; saving charts to an account is a separate, optional choice.
onboarding.tourSummaryBody: These short highlights give you a starting point. You don't have to understand every symbol to begin reading.
onboarding.tourSummaryExpert: Top Takeaways summarizes the chart's signals and current period. The supporting sections below let you inspect the detail.
onboarding.tourChartBody: This diagram maps planetary positions at birth. Lagna means rising sign; houses represent life areas. Use Help whenever a term is unfamiliar.
onboarding.tourChartExpert: Switch between the constellation and North Indian views, and inspect planetary positions alongside the chart.
onboarding.tourTimingBody: A dasha is a planetary period used in Vedic astrology. Explore the periods here, then open Timing below for forecasts and other timing tools.
onboarding.tourTimingExpert: Inspect the Vimshottari periods here. The Timing page below provides forecasts, annual-chart, and electional tools.
onboarding.tourExploreBody: The full reading brings together interpreted chart findings. You can also explore life areas from the overview. My Chart brings you back, and Help can replay this introduction.
onboarding.tourExploreExpert: Open the full reading for findings and planetary combinations. Explore life areas or divisional charts from the overview; Help can replay this tour.

walkthrough.launchTitle: Let me guide you on the page
walkthrough.launchBody: The walkthrough highlights real controls and gives you something to try at each stop.
walkthrough.savedChart: Guide me through my saved chart
walkthrough.everyVisit: Available on every visit. Replaying a guide does not change or erase your charts.
walkthrough.choosePeriod: Take me to the period choices
walkthrough.useDefault: Build my chart with the default
walkthrough.chooseHouses: Take me to the house styles
walkthrough.loading: Opening the page for your walkthrough…
walkthrough.unavailable: The walkthrough cannot find a ready chart here yet. You can retry the chart on the page, create one, or exit and reopen Help later.

Summary.task: Read one highlight, then find the card about your current period. These are starting points; the sections below show the details behind them.

Chart.task: Switch between the two chart views, then find the Ascendant row in the positions table. Both diagrams describe the same birth positions.

LifeAreas.title: Choose a question about your life
LifeAreas.body: Each life-area card is a different way into your reading. Selecting a card changes the short explanation below it.
LifeAreas.task: Click a life-area card that interests you, read its summary, then use the full-reading link for that area to see the supporting factors and guidance.

Timing.task: Choose one of the current-period rows to select it in the timeline and reading below. Compare its start and end dates; smaller periods sit inside larger ones.

Forecast.title: Find forecasts and date tools
Forecast.body: The Timing page contains forecasts, the annual chart, and a tool for exploring dates for an activity.
Forecast.task: Open the timing tools and choose the section matching your question. Your birth-period timeline stays on this overview; use the back link to return.

Explore.task: Open the full reading and select one finding or planetary combination. Read its explanation before moving to another. Use Back to your reading to return here.

Atlas.title: Go deeper when you are ready
Atlas.body: Divisional charts examine particular themes in more detail. This is an optional next step, especially sensitive to birth-time accuracy.
Atlas.task: Open the atlas and choose a chart by its stated theme. Begin with its explanation before studying positions; you can return to your birth chart at any time.

Default.title: Start with a ready-made method
Default.body: You do not have to understand every calculation choice to get your first reading.
Default.task: Use the default to build your chart now, or continue this guide to compare traditions and house styles. If you build it, the guide continues on your chart.

Tradition.title: Choose the zodiac reference
Tradition.body: The tradition determines where the sidereal zodiac starts. Its description changes when you select a row.
Tradition.task: Select a tradition and read the description beside it. Leave Lahiri selected if you are unsure. Your selection is shown above the chart-generation button.

Houses.title: Choose how houses are divided
Houses.body: House styles divide the same sky into life areas differently. They do not change the birth details you entered.
Houses.task: Select a house style and read its explanation, or keep Whole Sign. Then use See my chart below; this guide continues when the chart is ready.

intake.name: Enter the name you want on the reading. Sex at birth is optional. Use Continue to birth date below the form; this guide follows your next question.
intake.birthDate: Enter your birth date or use the calendar, then continue to birth time. Use the date recorded where you were born.
intake.birthTime: Enter your recorded birth time. If you do not know it, use the unknown-time option and choose an approximate part of the day. Then continue to birthplace.
intake.place: Search for your birthplace and select a matching suggestion, or use the manual fields. Once the details are ready, use the main button below to choose a method. The guide will continue there.

sections.lifeAreas: Choose a life area that interests you, then read its interpretation and supporting chart factors. You can return to the overview with Back to your reading.
sections.timing: Explore forecasts, the electional timing tool, and the annual chart. Your dasha periods are on the chart overview. Dates and interpretations depend on the supplied birth details.
sections.fullReading: Choose a finding or planetary combination to read its explanation. Explore one topic at a time; you can return to the overview whenever you like.
sections.divisional: These charts are derived from birth positions to examine particular themes. Start with the birth-chart overview; accurate birth time matters especially for finer divisions.
sections.advanced: Use these tables to inspect the calculations and chart factors behind a reading. Begin with the overview if you want a plain-language introduction.
sections.compatibility: Enter the other person's birth details to compare two charts. Read the individual factors as well as the overall interpretation.
sections.houseSupport: Explore how support is distributed across the houses. These scores are one chart factor to consider alongside the wider reading.
sections.lifeShifts: Explore interpreted changes in themes over time, alongside the periods that support them. Treat dates as dependent on your birth details.
sections.palm: Read your saved palm readings or compare them over time. When adding a photo, follow the capture instructions and review the photo before submitting it.

chart.name: Birth chart
chart.body: A map of planetary positions for your birth date, time, and place. It is the starting point for the readings on this site.

lagna.name: Lagna / Ascendant
lagna.body: The zodiac sign rising on the eastern horizon at birth. It helps orient the houses, so an accurate birth time matters.

house.name: House
house.body: One of twelve chart divisions associated with areas of life, such as work or relationships. The chosen house system determines the divisions.

dasha.name: Dasha
dasha.body: A planetary period used in Vedic astrology to interpret themes over time. Smaller periods sit within larger ones.

transit.name: Transit
transit.body: A planet's position at a particular time, considered alongside your birth chart. Transits describe a different layer from birth positions.

nakshatra.name: Nakshatra
nakshatra.body: One of 27 divisions of the zodiac used in Vedic astrology. The Moon's birth nakshatra is used to calculate the dasha sequence shown here.

yoga.name: Yoga
yoga.body: A planetary combination given a particular interpretation in astrology. Its meaning depends on the wider chart; a detected combination is not a promise of an outcome.

divisional.name: Divisional chart
divisional.body: An additional chart derived from birth positions to examine particular themes. Finer divisions can be especially sensitive to birth-time accuracy.

ayanamsha.name: Ayanamsha
ayanamsha.body: The reference offset used to position the sidereal zodiac. Choosing another tradition can shift signs or degrees near boundaries.

strength.name: Planetary strength
strength.body: A calculated measure of a planet's condition under particular astrological rules. A higher score is not a guarantee of a better life outcome.
